invariant_reasoning: extract the strictly nested filled rectangles from outside inward
normalize the hierarchy to concentric square layers
limitations: This task-local prototype is not selected, catalog-approved, or admitted for training.
Evidence covers two bounded settings and the retained seeds, not all possible variants.
The demonstrations eliminate only the declared thickness rival, not every imaginable rule.
Input sampling remains the canonical nested-rectangle grammar; no parameter is encoded in the query input.

parameter.meaning: Chebyshev thickness of each noncentral normalized output ring; the center remains one cell
parameter.name: ring_thickness

1.source:
(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((layers (let loop
                               ((r1 0) (c1 0) (r2 (- h 1)) (c2 (- w 1)) (acc (list)))
                               (let* ((outer (at g r1 c1))
                                      (inner-cells (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                                       #:when
                                                       (!= (at g r c) outer))
                                                     (list r c))))
                                 (cond
                                   ((null? inner-cells) (reverse (cons outer acc)))
                                   (else (let* ((ir1 (min-of first inner-cells))
                                                (ir2 (max-of first inner-cells))
                                                (ic1 (min-of second inner-cells))
                                                (ic2 (max-of second inner-cells)))
                                           (loop ir1 ic1 ir2 ic2 (cons outer acc))))))))
                  (layers-rev (reverse layers))
                  (n (length layers-rev))
                  (out-size (- (* 2 n) 1)))
             (build-grid out-size
                         out-size
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((mid (quotient out-size 2))
                                (dr (if (< r mid) (- mid r) (- r mid)))
                                (dc (if (< c mid) (- mid c) (- c mid)))
                                (dist (if (> dr dc) dr dc)))
                           (list-ref layers-rev dist)))))))

(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((layers (let loop
                               ((r1 0) (c1 0) (r2 (- h 1)) (c2 (- w 1)) (acc (list)))
                               (let* ((outer (at g r1 c1))
                                      (inner-cells (for*/list ((r (range r1 (+ r2 1))) (c (range c1 (+ c2 1)))
                                                       #:when
                                                       (!= (at g r c) outer))
                                                     (list r c))))
                                 (cond
                                   ((null? inner-cells) (reverse (cons outer acc)))
                                   (else (let* ((ir1 (min-of first inner-cells))
                                                (ir2 (max-of first inner-cells))
                                                (ic1 (min-of second inner-cells))
                                                (ic2 (max-of second inner-cells)))
                                           (loop ir1 ic1 ir2 ic2 (cons outer acc))))))))
                  (layers-rev (reverse layers))
                  (n (length layers-rev))
                  (ring-thickness 2)
                  (out-size (+ 1 (* 2 ring-thickness (- n 1)))))
             (build-grid out-size
                         out-size
                         (r c)
                         (let* ((mid (quotient out-size 2))
                                (dr (if (< r mid) (- mid r) (- r mid)))
                                (dc (if (< c mid) (- mid c) (- c mid)))
                                (dist (if (> dr dc) dr dc)))
                           (list-ref layers-rev (quotient (+ dist (- ring-thickness 1)) ring-thickness))))))))
